record.original_question: Does there exist a complete Boolean algebra whose Scott topology is non-sober?

evidence.quote: Question 3.7. Is there a complete Boolean algebra that has a non-sober Scott topology?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(L,\le)$ be a partially ordered set. A nonempty subset $D\subseteq L$ is directed if every two elements of $D$ have a common upper bound in $D$. A subset $U\subseteq L$ is Scott-open if (i) $U$ is an upper set (i.e. $x\in U$ and $x\le y$ imply $y\in U$) and (ii) for every directed subset $D\subseteq L$ that has a supremum $\bigvee D$, if $\bigvee D\in U$ then $D\cap U\neq\emptyset$. The collection of Scott-open subsets forms a topology on $L$, called the Scott topology $\sigma(L)$. A topological space $X$ is sober if every nonempty irreducible closed subset (a nonempty closed set that is not the union of two proper closed subsets) is the closure of a unique singleton. A Boolean algebra is a complemented distributive lattice; it is complete if every subset has a supremum (equivalently, an infimum). 

Question: Does there exist a complete Boolean algebra $B$ such that the Scott topology $\sigma(B)$ on $B$ is not sober?
artifact.status_search_result: The analogous question for complete Heyting algebras was answered positively (a complete Heyting algebra with non-sober Scott space exists, settling a problem of Jung). However, no source found resolves the question for complete Boolean algebras; recent work on sobriety of Scott topologies (e.g., 2025 arXiv preprints) still treats it as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: A complete Heyting algebra whose Scott space is non-sober
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs a complete Heyting algebra whose Scott space is non-sober, answering Jung's problem.
status_evidence.claim: The Heyting-algebra version is solved, but the Boolean-algebra refinement is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: When do weakly first-countable spaces and the Scott topology of open set lattice become sober?
status_evidence.snippet: Recent investigation of sobriety of Scott topologies; Boolean algebra case not resolved.
status_evidence.claim: Recent literature still considers sobriety of Scott topologies on complete lattices as an active topic.
